Completion downfield from a clean pocket.
Stopped at the 29 on third-and-4.
Makes a 47-yard field goal.

Completion over the middle with roughing the passer called. The caption's Philadelphia possession reference conflicts with the named passer and receiver.
Wide-open touchdown. Replay commentary says Quinyon Mitchell reacts to the other tight end going inside and recognizes Tremble's outside release too late.

plays.description: Completion after a fake handoff.
Completion into Carolina territory.
Receiver comes back for a soft throw at the 31-yard line; first name cannot be established.
Powers through a goal-line collision for a touchdown. Commentary credits Tyler Steen's block on the right side; DB records the run up the middle.

plays.description: Spins and carries a crowd toward midfield; penalty flag down, with no clear ruling supplied.
Takes an opening for a first down.
Third-and-10 pass incomplete with DeJean covering.
Makes a 52-yard field goal.
Stuffed for no gain needing a little more than a yard; Davis and Byron Young credited. Caption mentions Philadelphia and fourth down, leaving the exact down context uncertain.
Second-and-10 completion for a first down and additional yards after the catch.
Sacked; the defender's name is cut off.
Young leaves the pocket and completes a pass that Coker takes across the 40; Mukuba makes the tackle.

plays.description: First-down gain to just inside the 40; captions do not clearly establish whether this is a pass or run.
Converts fourth-and-less-than-a-yard and keeps driving through contact.
Steps up and scrambles on third-and-9, finishing just short of the first down against Jeremiah Trotter Jr.
Scores on second-and-goal.
Two-point conversion pass incomplete under pressure.
Wicks makes two defenders miss and zigzags into Carolina territory, then grabs his ankle.
Line-drive completion awarded a first down. Nearby captions say both second-and-10 and gain of four, so the down-and-distance context is uncertain.
Touchdown on a ball placed over Will Lee's head; Lee misses an attempted right-hand breakup.
Third-and-8 throw bounces incomplete, ending a three-and-out.
Third-and-18 throw described as lacking velocity; a flag is mentioned, but the pass result and ruling are unclear.
Philadelphia's kick is blocked by Carolina. The captions do not identify the kicker, blocker, or kick type.
Needs one yard and gains five for a first down. Philadelphia number 33 receives a subsequent 15-yard unnecessary-roughness penalty.
Second Tremble touchdown. Young fakes the handoff, boots right and throws back left; commentary says Philadelphia loses Tremble in coverage. Tremble is penalized for taunting after the score.
plays.concept: Play-action boot right with throwback left

plays.description: Completion as Philadelphia drives; receiver identified only as Lemon.
Contested deep pass incomplete with Wheatley defending.
Catch and run to the Philadelphia 13; Byron Young catches Moore from behind.
Squeezes through for a first-down run with 3:24 remaining.
Runs for another first down, allowing Carolina to kneel out the game.
Takes the final kneel-down.

offense_strengths: Tremble scored twice on releases that confused Philadelphia: a delayed outside release and a play-action throwback.
Hubbard converted multiple short-yardage situations, scored at the goal line and supplied late first downs to finish the game.
Coker's 32-yard reception and Moore's 27-yard catch and run produced substantial gains from DB-listed short passes.
defense_weaknesses: Smith beat Will Lee for a 19-yard touchdown despite close coverage.
Philadelphia gained 18 yards through Goedert and 17 through Wicks; Wicks made two unnamed defenders miss.
Pierce powered through contact for a two-yard touchdown.

offense_strengths: McKee connected repeatedly with Smith, including a 16-yard gain and a 19-yard touchdown.
Goedert supplied a play-action completion and a separate 18-yard catch and run.
Pierce finished a goal-line run through contact, with commentary crediting Steen's blocking.
defense_weaknesses: Mitchell reacted to the inside tight-end movement and recognized Tremble's touchdown release too late.
The defense lost Tremble on Carolina's boot-right, throwback-left touchdown.
Carolina generated 32- and 27-yard receptions and several Hubbard first-down runs.
A late unnecessary-roughness penalty added 15 yards after Hubbard's five-yard conversion.
